caveats: All 92 target days and all 4028 baseline-window days (1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05) were available and analysed. No per-cell MHW was found in any sea cell (longest run of hot days was 2, below the 5-day minimum), hence no regional MHW events; 297 of the 3600 region cells are non-sea (no SST on some target days) and are 0 in the mask.
